drew: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector rollout we see host-side parse + tokenization CPU up ~22% on streaming gRPC paths. traces attached. :frowning:

jess: Which clusters/regions? e2e or just canary?

drew: Canary in us-west-2. e2e perf tests show throughput flat but p50/p95 CPU and tails spiked. Noticed more repeated tokenization calls on the same request prefixes.

matt: Could be batching heuristics changed kernel choice -> different prefetch pattern? Also check KV cache hit rates.

olga: Any flamegraphs or top stacks? smallframes vs largeframe diff?

_drew pasted flame snippet:_
```
hot  samples  flat  name
60%   1200   720   parse::ParseProtoMessage
18%    360    54   tokenizer::tokenize_utf8
8%     160    16   grpc::writev_small_writes
4%      80     20  kvcache::lookup_prefix
```

jess: Wow parse::ParseProtoMessage dominating. That hints parsing path is being taken more often (maybe we lost preflight).

drew: Agreed. Looking at request traces: retries + fallback path cause reparse and re-tokenize of the same prefix. KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 61% on canary.

matt: That explains CPU. If kernel selector prefers a quantized kernel for some sequences, it may change the request path and disable the quick-prefix early-exit we rely on.

perf-bot: perf/regressions detected: canary-2026-03-09 -> host-parse +20% CPU, tokenization calls +45%, kv-hit-rate delta -31pp. See /perf/reports/1919191919

olga: Short-term mitigations?

jess: I have a small patch to re-enable prefix-KV sticky hits for streaming sessions (rev: r1234). It forces KV lookup coalescing on the handshake path so retries reuse the same prefix key.

matt: Also lowering grpc small-write flush interval from 8ms -> 4ms reduced small-write CPU by ~6% in local repro. Might help tail latency.

drew: Plan: roll r1234 + grpc small-write change to 10% canary tonight, collect kvcache/hotkey metrics + flame snapshots. If stable, promote.

olga: Add a perf test covering kernel-selector combos + batching heuristics (small frame streaming, variable seq len). We should catch this in CI.

drew: Will add tests and tag @oncall in rollout. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
